connection_operations.name: connection_operations
connection_operations.title: Connection Operations
connection_operations.description: Perform operations on Microsoft tabular semantic model data source connections (PowerBI Desktop, Analysis Services, Fabric). Supported operations: Help, Connect, ConnectFabric, ConnectFolder, ConnectBimFile, Disconnect, GetConnection, ListConnections, ListLocalInstances. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform.

operation.description: Help, Connect, ConnectFabric, ConnectFolder, ConnectBimFile, Disconnect, GetConnection, ListConnections, ListLocalInstances

connectionName.description: Required for GetConnection. Optional for Disconnect (disconnects all if omitted). Forbidden for Connect, ConnectFabric, ConnectFolder, ConnectBimFile (auto-generated)

connectionString.description: Required for Connect. Supports PowerBI Desktop, XML/A, Analysis Services

workspaceName.description: Required for ConnectFabric name-based connections, exact match. Must be supplied with SemanticModelName.

semanticModelName.description: Required for ConnectFabric name-based connections, exact match. Must be supplied with WorkspaceName.

workspaceId.description: Required for ConnectFabric ID-based connections. Must be a GUID and supplied with SemanticModelId

semanticModelId.description: Required for ConnectFabric ID-based connections. Must be a GUID and supplied with WorkspaceId

folderPath.description: For ConnectFolder. Must contain database.tmdl or have 'definition' subfolder

table_operations.name: table_operations
table_operations.title: Table Operations
table_operations.description: Perform operations on semantic model tables. All operations support both single and multiple items via list properties. Supported operations: Help, Create, CreateFieldParameter, Update, Delete, Get, List, RefreshWithXMLA, RefreshWithAPI, CheckStatusOfRefreshWithAPI, CancelRefreshWithAPI, Rename, MarkAsDateTable, GetSchema, ExportTMDL, ExportTMSL. For Create and Update use Definitions, for Delete, Get, Refresh, GetSchema, ExportTMDL, and ExportTMSL use References, and for Rename use RenameDefinitions. Batch options allow control over transaction behavior and error handling.

connectionName.description: Uses the last connection if omitted.

operation.description: Help, Create, CreateFieldParameter, Update, Delete, Get, List, RefreshWithXMLA, RefreshWithAPI, CheckStatusOfRefreshWithAPI, CancelRefreshWithAPI, Rename, MarkAsDateTable, GetSchema, ExportTMDL, ExportTMSL

references.description: For Delete and Get operations; single item for RefreshWithXMLA, GetSchema, ExportTMDL, and ExportTMSL.

maxReturnCharacters.description: Maximum characters to return (-1=no limit, 0=don't return, >0=limit). Default: 10000

refreshType.description: Full, ClearValues, Calculate, DataOnly, Automatic, Add, Defragment. For Refresh only

maxReturnCharacters.description: Maximum characters to return (-1=no limit, 0=don't return, >0=limit). Default: 10000

fieldParameterDefinitions.description: For CreateFieldParameter operation. List of field parameter table definitions, each with Name and Fields (ordered list of column/measure references with TableName, Name, ObjectType, and optional DisplayName).

refreshType.description: For RefreshWithAPI operation: refresh type — Automatic, Full, DataOnly, Calculate.

requestId.description: For CheckStatusOfRefreshWithAPI operation: the request ID returned by RefreshWithAPI.

options.description: Batch operation options such as ContinueOnError and UseTransaction.

measure_operations.name: measure_operations
measure_operations.title: Measure Operations
measure_operations.description: Perform operations on semantic model measures. All operations support both single and multiple items via list properties. Supported operations: Help, Create, Update, Delete, Get, List, Rename, Move, ExportTMDL. For Create and Update use Definitions. For Delete, Get, List, and ExportTMDL use References. For Rename use RenameDefinitions. For Move use MoveDefinitions. To move measures between tables, use the Move operation. Update operation cannot change table assignment; use Move instead. Batch options allow control over transaction behavior and error handling.

connectionName.description: Uses the last connection if omitted.

operation.description: Help, Create, Update, Delete, Get, List, Rename, Move, ExportTMDL

references.description: For Delete, Get, and ExportTMDL operations.

tableName.description: Optional if measure name is unique
Optional if measure name is unique

currentTableName.description: Optional if measure name is unique

maxReturnCharacters.description: Maximum characters to return (-1=no limit, 0=don't return, >0=limit). Default: 10000

options.description: Batch operation options such as ContinueOnError and UseTransaction.

connectionName.description: Uses the last connection if omitted.

dax_query_operations.name: dax_query_operations
dax_query_operations.title: DAX Query Operations
dax_query_operations.description: Perform DAX query operations on semantic models. Supported operations: Help, Execute, Validate, ClearCache. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform.

connectionName.description: Uses the last connection if omitted.

query.description: DAX query text for Execute and Validate operations.

timeoutSeconds.description: Default: 200 seconds for Execute, 10 seconds for Validate.

maxRows.description: Execute only. Maximum number of rows to return (default 1000; limit of 100000).

getExecutionMetrics.description: Execute only. Captures query execution metrics when true. Default: false.

executionMetricsOnly.description: When true with GetExecutionMetrics, omits row data but reads all rows for accurate timing. Default: false.

impersonation.description: Execute only. Optional impersonation options for query execution.

roles.description: Security role names to apply via the Roles connection string property.

userPrincipalName.description: User principal name to impersonate via the EffectiveUserName connection string property.

resultMode.description: Execute only. Selects how results are returned: 'Resource' (default, embedded resource) or 'Inline'(JSON text) — best for clients that don't support MCP resources.
